page_title: BRE 1-1 MNU | Brentford v Manchester Utd 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' Simon Hooper is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+12' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+12' Neal Maupay (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90+12' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
90+12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
90+9' 1 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Ivan Toney finds Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:1.
90+6' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Casemiro tees up Mason Mount (Manchester United) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Mark Flekken.
90+5' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
87' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) replaces Keane Lewis-Potter.
86' Ivan Toney (Brentford) has a go from mid-range after he found himself in acres of space after a clever pass from Bryan Mbeumo. The shot is a good one, but slips just wide of the right post.
86' A substitution has been made. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen is replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
85' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul. Brentford have a free kick from a promising distance.
83' Zanka (Brentford) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
83' Ivan Toney (Brentford) latched on to a fine cross from the corner kick on the edge of the box. His shot, however, flies narrowly over the bar.
83' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
82' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
80' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Kobbie Mainoo is replaced by Casemiro (Manchester United).
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mason Mount (Manchester United) will replace Marcus Rashford.

79' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) wasted a golden opportunity after expertly receiving a cross from the free kick and shooting from close range. Unfortunately for him, his aim was off and he hit the crossbar!
77' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Onana is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
76' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) tries to find Mads Roerslev Rasmussen, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.
74' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Brentford players look gutted.
73' Wait! Referee Simon Hooper immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
73' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Ivan Toney (Brentford) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
72' That was close by Antony (Manchester United)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
71' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) replacing Yegor Yarmolyuk.
71' It's time for a substitution. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) comes on in place of Yoane Wissa.

70' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his shot flies just over the crossbar. This should be a big warning for the defence.
70' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

70' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
70' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Victor Lindelof is substituted due to injury. Erik ten Hag gives a chance to Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United).
68' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

68' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
66' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
65' Ivan Toney (Brentford) rips an amazing volley from deep inside the box that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
62' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
59' Alejandro Garnacho goes off the pitch and Antony (Manchester United) comes on.
59' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) smashed a volley without hesitation from near the penalty spot, but it only rattled the left post!
57' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
56' Excellent touch by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
55' A quickly taken corner by Manchester Utd.

54' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mark Flekken pulls off a brilliant save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Manchester Utd.
54' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' Bruno Fernandes has a look up and finds Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
50' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Mark Flekken, who makes a comfortable save.
49' Ivan Toney (Brentford) tries to find Vitaly Janelt with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
49' PENALTY APPEAL after Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
48' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
47' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
47' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Erik ten Hag probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Raphael Varane. He is replaced by Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' The free kick is taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but ball is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Yoane Wissa (Brentford) for his blatant foul.

44' What a save from Andre Onana! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the left post, but the goalkeeper has pulled off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
44' Corner kick. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) is ready to send the ball into the box.
43' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Brentford force a corner. They send men into the box.
42' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) sends it out of play.
41' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Raphael Varane (Manchester United) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
35' A clever short pass gives Yoane Wissa (Brentford) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
35' Ivan Toney (Brentford) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
33' Zanka (Brentford) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
33' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes a short corner kick.
32' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Good work from Brentford as they win a corner.
29' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
28' Good defending. Ivan Toney (Brentford) tries to find Yegor Yarmolyuk inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
26' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) bravely wins the ball from the corner but can't direct it on target, sending it well wide of the left post from near the penalty spot.
25' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
24' A great pass puts Ivan Toney (Brentford) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
23' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Andre Onana easily deals with the threat.
22' An accurate cross picks out Zanka (Brentford) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
22' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

21' Ivan Toney (Brentford) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
21' A player from Manchester Utd pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Brentford are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
19' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

19' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Brentford will take a corner kick.
18' The ball goes out of play and Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
18' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mathias Jensen (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Brentford get a corner.
18' Brentford take a short corner kick.
17' The cross into the penalty area from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
16' Rasmus Hojlund receives a sweet cross inside the box from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
15' Manchester Utd take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

15' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
11' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
7' Ivan Toney (Brentford) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
7' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) steps up to send the ball in.
6' An attempted cross from Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Brentford.
3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
2' Simon Hooper interrupts the game. One of the players from Manchester Utd won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Brentford earn a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Manchester Utd will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simon Hooper.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
